mods.name: Obsidian API
mods.summary: A library other mods build on. It does nothing by itself.
mods.description:
A library for [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mods on HELLDIVERS (2015). It gives other mods the game data by name, checked changes that can be undone, and ready actions. It does nothing by itself.

## How to use

Obsidian API comes with Obsidian, in the Obsidian Kit. Mods that need it switch it on with them.

To build on it, list it in the `obsidian.json` of the mod:

```json
"requires": ["obsidian.api"]
```

Then ask for it in the script:

```lua
local api = obsidian.import("obsidian.api")

obsidian.keybind("panic", function()
  api.player.heal()
  api.enemies.kill_near(20)
end)
```

Actions answer `true`, or `false` and a short reason such as `"host_only"`. A client mod can require the API and stay a client mod: it can read game data and use the interface, sound and event calls, and anything that changes the shared game answers `false, "needs_session"`.

[REFERENCE.md](REFERENCE.md) has every call, with guides and recipes. A copy sits in the folder of the API in the Obsidian Kit, where an AI tool working on a mod can read it.

## Known issues

- Tested solo and offline, not yet with a second player.

option_list.description: The buttons that open and close the F6 menu from a controller, pressed together. In the menu, the D-pad or the left stick moves, A selects, B goes back, Y resets a row, and LB and RB switch pages.

option_list.label: Script Profiler
option_list.description: Adds the Script Profiler page to the F6 menu: a panel over the game with the time the scripts of each mod take every frame. On its page the panel can still be hidden. Off, nothing is measured.

option_list.label: Memory Bridge
option_list.description: For making mods. Runs Lua that a developer tool sends while the game runs, and answers it, so a mod can be tried without a restart. Code runs only alone or in a lobby that isn't public. While it is on, Galactic War and leaderboard results aren't sent. Any program on this PC can send it code: leave it off unless making mods.

mods.name: Obsidian Patches
mods.summary: Small fixes and conveniences for the game.
mods.description:
Small fixes for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Obsidian Patches removes the black bars on wide screens, skips the intro, the login screen and the planet scans, speeds up the mission end, pauses the game in solo missions, and fixes the recoil and sprint animations.

## How to use

Obsidian Patches comes with Obsidian, in the Obsidian Kit, switched on. Each fix is an option in Obsidian and takes effect at the next launch. Four of them can also be changed in game, under **Mods** in the pause menu, and apply at once.

option_list.label: Widescreen fixes
option_list.description: No black bars on screens wider than 16:9, dialogue boxes and galaxy map panels at the real edges of the screen, and the objective list halfway out toward the right edge.

option_list.label: Expedite mission end
option_list.description: Faster gives each results screen about a second. Instant skips to the last one. Rewards are saved either way.

option_list.label: Skip intro
option_list.description: No logos or intro video at launch.

option_list.label: Skip login screen
option_list.description: Starts on the ship, still online. With a gamepad connected, the first press on the title screen picks the player 1 controls; without one, keyboard and mouse.

option_list.label: Skip war briefs
option_list.description: Hides the war briefs on the ship and the galaxy map, at login and as the war moves. The end of a war still plays.

option_list.label: Skip planet scanning
option_list.description: No planet discovery animation after a liberation or a new sector.

option_list.label: Dynamic solo pause
option_list.description: With a single player in the mission, the pause menu freezes the game, even in a public or friends-only lobby. The game resumes as soon as someone joins.

option_list.label: Aim cursor always visible
option_list.description: On PC, the cursor keeps the aiming look at all times, instead of dimming between shots.

option_list.label: Toggle minimap
option_list.description: The map key opens the minimap and keeps it open until pressed again, instead of only while held.

option_list.label: Weapon recoil animation fix
option_list.description: Every weapon taken in hand plays the matching recoil animation, whatever was in hand before.

option_list.label: Sprint pose fix
option_list.description: Sprinting right after getting up from a dive shows the normal running pose, instead of an upper body stuck until the sprint starts over.

option_list.label: Rumbler echo fix
option_list.description: A Rumbler burst plays the firing sound and flash once, without a second shot with no shell about a second later.

option_list.label: Borderless white frame fix
option_list.description: In borderless fullscreen, the thin white line around the screen goes, and the picture fills the whole screen.

mods.name: Obsidian Trainer
mods.summary: An in-game menu that changes the character, gear, enemies and missions.
mods.description:
An in-game menu for HELLDIVERS (2015) that changes the character, weapons, stratagems, enemies, missions and game data, for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Missions add nothing to the save while the Trainer is on, and it stays out of the Galactic War. It offers only the base game and owned DLC.

## How to use

1. Switch on Obsidian Trainer in the Mods tab. [Obsidian API](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianAPI) turns on with it.
2. Deploy, then start the game.
3. Press **F6** to open the menu. The key can be changed in the Keys tab of Obsidian API.

The Obsidian Trainer page in the Wiki of Obsidian lists every key and page.

mods.name: Better HUD
mods.summary: Adds useful and configurable HUD elements: on-character ammo count, enemy and ally health bars that show status effects and damage numbers.
mods.description:
More information on the HUD of HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Better HUD counts the rounds left in the magazine and the grenades on each player card, puts health and stamina bars under the player cards and health bars over enemies, and shows damage numbers where hits land. A reload circle and an ammo circle sit beside the Helldiver. Enemy bars show burns, poison and stuns, and wait at the edge of the screen while the enemy is out of view.

## How to use

Every part can be switched on or off in the options of Better HUD in Obsidian, or in game under **Mods → Better HUD** in the pause menu. A change in one place shows in the other.

## Known issues

- Players on other computers get no stamina bar: the game keeps stamina on each player's computer and never sends it.
- Lasers and arc weapons get no round counter, since they heat or charge up instead. The ammo circle shows their heat or charge.

Mod authors can add meters, flashes and status icons to the HUD through Better HUD: see [docs/api.md](docs/api.md).

mods.name: Photo Mode
mods.summary: A photo mode! Default F7 to open.
mods.description:
A photo mode for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Photo Mode stops the mission, clears the HUD and hands over the camera. A panel of controls sets the lens, depth of field, filters, fog, the time of day and the sun, places up to eight lights, and poses the Helldiver. Pictures are saved to `Pictures\Helldivers`.

## How to use

Press **F7**, or pick **PHOTO MODE** in the pause menu, during a mission or on the ship. Esc or F7 leaves, and everything goes back as it was.

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| W A S D, Q E | Move the camera |
| Right mouse button | Look around |
| Mouse wheel | Field of view, distance or zoom |
| Shift, Alt | Faster, slower |
| Left mouse button, twice | Focus on the point under the cursor |
| P | Take a picture |
| H | Hide or show the panel |

P, H and F7 can be changed in the Keys tab of Photo Mode in Obsidian.

## Known issues

- With other players in the lobby the game keeps running, as pausing one game would split it from the others.
- In exclusive fullscreen, pictures can come out black. Borderless or windowed mode works.
- Photo Mode does not open while Third Person Camera is installed.

option_list.label: Fix skies
option_list.description: Clears the part of the picture past the level, where the game leaves smears of old frames, and adds the skies of the Sky row. Takes effect at the next launch.

mods.name: Enhanced Visuals
mods.summary: Adds ambient occlusion, higher shadow resolution, supersampling, ambient light and other graphical enhancements.
mods.description:
Better graphics and extra visual effects for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

The mod turns on the ambient occlusion pass that the game ships but never runs, adds sharpening and an ambient light effect, raises the resolution and distance of sun shadows, softens shadow edges, keeps detailed models farther from the camera, and can draw the scene above the screen resolution.

## How to use

**F9** switches between Enhanced Visuals and the plain game, to compare. The key can be changed in Obsidian.

For the game textures at twice the size, see [Upscaled Textures](https://github.com/Alomare/HD1-UpscaledTextures), a separate mod that works with or without this one.

## Known issues

- Third Person Camera also uses F9: with both mods on, change one of the keys. Put Enhanced Visuals after Third Person Camera in the load order, or the shadow and render scale options do nothing.
- A shadow resolution of 8192 takes 256 MB of video memory.

mods.name: Eyes of Liberty
mods.summary: Highly compatible and customizable third person experience. Camera shake, compass, pings and more!
mods.description:
A third person camera for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager. Formerly Unleashed Camera, and before that Integrated Third Person: remove either one when installing this mod. Based on [Third Person Camera (HD2 Style)](https://github.com/yukiorsrs/third-person-camera-helldivers) by **yukiorsrs**, rebuilt with the permission of the author so that other mods keep working beside it.

The camera follows the Helldiver over the shoulder on foot, in vehicles and on the ship. Shots leave along the way the weapon points, and the weapon swings onto the crosshair while aiming or firing; the crosshair shows where it points meanwhile. Grenades and stratagems go where the crosshair points. The view reaches farther, the sky over the level is filled in, a ring around the crosshair warns of enemies close by, a bar shows where hits come from, and the edges of the screen flash red when the Helldiver is hurt. A compass at the top of the screen shows the way to the objectives found on the map. Stratagem beacons out of view show at the edge of the screen, as do allies, red while down, and a dashed line shows where a held grenade or stratagem ball would fly. The ping key marks enemies, objectives, dropped support weapons or a spot on the ground for the squad. After a death the camera stays on the body, then follows a living ally until the Helldiver is back. After extraction it rides the shuttle out.

Third Person Camera replaces 28 game scripts, so mods that change the same parts of the game stop working with it. Eyes of Liberty replaces no script: every change is a hook through Obsidian.

## How to use

**F8** switches between the top-down camera of the game and third person. **H** swaps the shoulder. **F** pings what the crosshair is on. The keys can be changed in Obsidian. On a gamepad, the right stick turns the camera and holding the left trigger aims; while aiming, the reload button throws grenades. A tap of the right stick swaps the shoulder. While the death cam follows allies, left and right click switch between them.

## Playing with others

The camera and everything on screen work in any lobby. Five session features change the game for the whole lobby: Ballistics revamp (every weapon reaches far, with damage falling off past the weapon's own range), Far enemy detection, Free movement, Increased throw range and Patrols stay in view. They run only when every player runs Obsidian with the same mods, and switch off when anyone else joins. With all five off, the mod counts as a client mod.

Pings show only for teammates who run the mod; nothing goes to the game's chat.

## Known issues

- Players on one computer share a screen, so the camera goes back to top-down while a second local player is in, and comes back after.
- The mod stays off while Third Person Camera, Unleashed Camera or Integrated Third Person is installed.

First person is in development for separate beta versions.

Mod authors can read the camera state through `obsidian.import("alomare.eyesofliberty")`: `active()`, `mode()`, `crosshair()` and `shoulder()`.

option_list.label: Camera mode
option_list.description: The camera at the start of the game. Default is the top-down camera of the game. The camera key switches between the two in a mission.

option_list.label: Look sensitivity
option_list.description: How fast the camera turns with the mouse or the right stick.

option_list.label: Invert vertical look
option_list.description: Moving the mouse up looks down.

option_list.label: Shoulder
option_list.description: The side of the Helldiver the camera sits on. The swap key, or a tap of the right stick on a gamepad, changes it in a mission. A mech camera starts on the same side; in any vehicle the swap key moves the camera from left to the middle to right.

option_list.label: Distance on foot (m)
option_list.description: Meters between the camera and the Helldiver on foot in a mission.

option_list.label: Camera sideways distance (m)
option_list.description: Meters between the camera and the shoulder of the Helldiver, to the side. The camera comes a little closer while aiming.

option_list.label: Hide stowed support weapon
option_list.description: The support weapon carried on the back is hidden while another weapon is in hand, so a long one such as the Dum-Dum doesn't block the view. Only on this screen.

option_list.label: Scroll camera distance
option_list.description: On foot with a mouse, the wheel moves the camera closer or farther, from 1 to 10 m, and no longer switches weapons. Number keys still switch weapons. Changing the distance on foot above starts over from that distance.

option_list.label: Field of view on foot (degrees)
option_list.description: Vertical field of view on foot in third person.

option_list.label: Overall camera height (m)
option_list.description: Raises or lowers the third-person camera on foot, in a dive, while down, in vehicles and on the Super Destroyer.

option_list.label: Distance on the Super Destroyer (m)
option_list.description: Meters between the camera and the Helldiver on the Super Destroyer.

option_list.label: Hellpod camera
option_list.description: When the Helldiver drops in, the camera rides down above the Hellpod looking down on it, shakes on the landing, and glides into the shoulder view once the Helldiver climbs out. The view stays still until then. When another pod of the squad comes down first, the camera waits high above it, then moves over to the pod of the Helldiver.

option_list.label: Dive camera
option_list.description: Brings the camera down during a dive, quickly but smoothly, and eases it back up once the dive ends.

option_list.label: Downed camera
option_list.description: While the Helldiver is down and crawling, the camera sits as low as in a dive, and 1 m farther back.

option_list.label: Death cam
option_list.description: When the Helldiver dies, the camera stays on the body, or where the body was once the game removes it, until the Helldiver drops in again or the mission ends. With allies alive, the camera moves to one of them after 4 seconds. Left and right click switch between allies, and the mouse turns the camera. Until the camera moves to an ally, the ping key still marks what the middle of the screen is on.

option_list.label: Extraction camera
option_list.description: Once the Helldiver boards the shuttle, the camera rides with the shuttle as it takes off and flies away, until the mission ends. The mouse turns the camera.

option_list.label: Camera shake strength
option_list.description: How much explosions, impacts and the Hellpod landing shake the shoulder camera.

option_list.label: Explosion kick
option_list.description: In third person, an explosion nearby knocks the camera: it rolls away from the blast, tips up and rises, then eases back. Grenades kick lightly, within about 9 m; bigger blasts kick harder and from farther, a Hellbomb from about 50 m. Blasts in quick succession kick less each time. Hellpod landings don't kick. Follows the Camera shake setting.

option_list.label: Vehicle camera distance (m)
option_list.description: Meters between the camera and the vehicle: mech, APC, bike and turrets. A mech camera sits beside the shoulder, other vehicles in the middle and high.

option_list.label: Vehicle field of view (degrees)
option_list.description: Vertical field of view in a vehicle.

option_list.label: Throw arc
option_list.description: In third person, while a grenade or a stratagem ball is held, a dashed line shows the way it would fly if thrown now, and a ring where it first lands. On the throw, both stay in place and fade out over a second. While aiming the Rumbler or the Obliterator, the line shows the flight of the shell, and a circle the blast of each shell.

option_list.label: Weapon ergonomics
option_list.description: In third person on foot, every shot leaves along the way the weapon points, and the weapon swings onto the crosshair while aiming or firing. The crosshair shows where the weapon points. Off, shots go straight to the crosshair, and the weapon tilts up and down no faster than the Helldiver turns.

option_list.label: Weapon follows aim
option_list.description: In third person on foot, while aiming or firing, the Helldiver bends up or down so the weapon points where the crosshair is. Only on this screen: other players see the pose of the game.

option_list.label: Ammo bar
option_list.description: In third person on foot, a short arc by the crosshair shows the magazine left, the heat of a laser or the charge of an arc weapon, with the colours, warnings and reload button of the Better HUD ammo circle. With the Rumbler, a thin white band beside it fills as the charge builds. Shows from a shot and fades out 8 seconds after the last one. While on, the Better HUD ammo circle stays hidden in third person.

option_list.label: Ammo bar position
option_list.description: Where the ammo bar sits around the crosshair. The sides follow the camera when the shoulder swaps.

option_list.label: Curved ammo bar
option_list.description: On, the ammo bar curves around the crosshair. Off, the bar is straight.

option_list.label: Ammo bar scale
option_list.description: The size of the ammo bar and how far it sits from the crosshair.

option_list.label: Ammo bar length
option_list.description: How long the ammo bar is, as a multiple of the default length, a sixth of a circle around the crosshair.

option_list.label: Compass
option_list.description: In third person, a compass at the top of the screen turns with the camera and shows the way to every objective found on the map and to every map marker a player has placed, in the colour of that player.

option_list.label: Compass width
option_list.description: How wide the compass is. A wider compass shows more of the way around, with the letters as far apart as before.

option_list.label: Compass background opacity
option_list.description: How solid the panel behind the compass is: 1 is solid, 0 leaves only the frame, the letters and the icons.

option_list.label: Show view angle
option_list.description: The line in the middle of the compass and the heading in degrees under it.

option_list.label: Pings
option_list.description: In third person, the ping key marks what the crosshair is on: ground, an enemy, an objective, a dropped support weapon or pack, an ammo box or a research sample, also while down, and after death until the camera moves to an ally. Teammates with the mod see the marker too and hear the chat sound; players without the mod see and hear nothing.

option_list.label: Enemy indicators
option_list.description: A ring around the crosshair in four segments. The right, back and left segments show faintly while an enemy is in range on that side, and stronger within half the range. The side with the closest enemy within half the range also shows a warning triangle. Shows only while the Helldiver is alive or down, and is hidden while the game is paused.

option_list.label: Enemy indicator range (m)
option_list.description: Enemies closer than this show on the ring; within half of it, the segment is stronger.

option_list.label: Edge markers
option_list.description: In third person, stratagem beacons out of view show at the edge of the screen, with their own icons.

option_list.label: Stratagem beacon icon
option_list.description: In third person, with the crosshair on the light beam of a stratagem beacon, the icon of the stratagem shows on the beam at the height of the crosshair.

option_list.label: Names above heads
option_list.description: In third person, the name cards of players show above their heads instead of at their feet.

option_list.label: Hurt indicator
option_list.description: A bar near the crosshair points toward where a hit came from and fades within 2 seconds: red when health is lost, yellow when the personal shield takes it, white when the vehicle does. A bar for an enemy follows the enemy.

option_list.label: Hurt feedback
option_list.description: When the Helldiver loses health, the edges of the screen flash red and the camera shakes briefly, both stronger for a bigger hit. The shake follows the Camera shake option and shows in third person only.

option_list.label: Alarm effect
option_list.description: In third person, an alarm makes the screen edges pulse red once and flashes broad red stripes up both sides, in place of the red overlay of the game. Off shows the overlay of the game.

option_list.label: Reduce fog
option_list.description: How fast the fog of the level builds up with distance: 1 is the game's fog, 0.5 half as fast, 0 no fog at all. option_list.description: Game default keeps the blur of the planet. Focus on the Helldiver keeps the Helldiver sharp and blurs what lies a metre or more nearer or farther. Off keeps the whole picture sharp. Photo Mode sets the depth of field while open.

option_list.label: Long view distance
option_list.description: Pushes the far edge of the view and the detail of distant models out, so distant enemies and landmarks show. The fog is left to Reduce fog.

option_list.label: Sky
option_list.description: Draws a sky over the level for the time of the mission, dawn, day, dusk or night, instead of the smears the game leaves past the level: brighter toward the horizon, with the sun where the light of the level comes from, clouds, and stars and a moon at night. Needs a deploy.

option_list.label: Ship in the sky
option_list.description: In third person during a mission, the Super Destroyer of the loading screen hangs in the sky, side on, high over the horizon on the side away from the sun.

option_list.label: Ballistics revamp
option_list.description: Every weapon reaches as far as the farthest one, so targets far off in the third-person view can be hit. Past a weapon's own range, bullets lose damage over 15 m, down to a fifth, and keep that fifth beyond. Lasers keep their damage. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

option_list.description: Enemies notice and chase the squad from much farther away. Alarm range stays as in the game. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

A crosshair mod for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager.

Custom Crosshair replaces the aim cursor with a crosshair built from shapes, with one look between shots and another while aiming. Shape, size, gap, color, outline and shadow are all settings. A hitmarker flashes around the crosshair, with a sound, when a shot from this player hurts or kills an enemy.

The settings are in the Options tab of Custom Crosshair in Obsidian, with a live preview. A change applies at the next launch of the game.

## Known issues

- On a controller the game shows no cursor in the top-down view, so no crosshair shows there.
- A shot that armor stops does not count as a hit.

Arcade game modes for HELLDIVERS (2015), for the [Obsidian](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianLauncher) mod manager. The first mode is Super Earth Survivors.

A mode inspired by Vampire Survivors. The squad drops on an open map and holds out against waves that grow stronger over time. A second faction joins at 6 minutes and the third at 12, with elites, bosses and bombardments along the way.

Kills drop research samples. Each level up freezes the fight, refills health and lets every player pick one of three upgrade cards; every third level adds a stratagem. Open the galaxy map and pick the **ARCADE** tab, beside Proving Grounds. Choose the faction, the difficulty and the biome, then Launch. The next drop plays the same mission again until a campaign mission is picked.

Arcade missions leave the Galactic Campaign as it was.

## Playing with others

Until the host picks an arcade mission, the mod runs as a client mod and anyone can join. An arcade mission needs every player in the lobby to run Helldivers Arcade at the same version.

A mod for HELLDIVERS (2015) that brings the squad resupply from HELLDIVERS 2, for [Obsidian Mod Manager](https://github.com/Alomare/ObsidianModManager).

## What it does

Every player carries a yellow Resupply stratagem in every mission. It is listed with the mission stratagems (Reinforce, SOS Beacon, Hellbomb), on top of the four picks.

- Code: ↓ ↓ ↑ →.
- Drops one crate with four ammunition boxes (2 to 4 with the Ammo box count option).
- Call-in time is 10 seconds. No upgrades.
- Cooldown is 180 seconds and is shared by the whole squad: when anyone calls it, everyone waits. Players who join mid-mission take the squad's current cooldown.

The standard (blue) Resupply is removed from the Arsenal, the Loadout screen and loadouts.

## Options

- **Preserve vanilla Resupply** (off by default): keeps the standard Resupply in the Arsenal, the Loadout screen and loadouts. It then uses the code ↓ ↓ ↑ ↑.
- **Ammo box count** (4 by default): how many ammunition boxes the crate holds, from 2 to 4. The setting of the player who calls the Resupply decides.

## Playing with others

Every player in the lobby needs Shared Resupply, at the same version and with the same Preserve vanilla Resupply setting. Saved loadouts that held the standard Resupply get another stratagem in place of it, or keep it in the slot when no other stratagem fits; it is left out in missions.

Needs Obsidian API 1.40.0 or later.

Stim injectors for HELLDIVERS. Each Helldiver carries up to two stims by default (one to four with the Maximum stim count option) and starts every drop and respawn with a full set. An ammo box gives two more, and can be picked up for stims alone when every weapon is full.

A stim takes the key (V by default): the Helldiver raises the left fist and stabs the injector into the neck, standing, moving or prone. Unless a knockdown, a reload, a throw or a melee cuts the motion short, the stim gives four seconds of endless stamina and 60 health a second, up to full health. The Helldiver moves at aiming speed while the injection plays, the screen edges glow light blue while the stim lasts, and another stim can start once the four seconds of the last one are over. With none left, "Out of stims!" shows over the Helldiver.

While a stim lasts, the Helldiver takes no status effects such as fire, poison, stun, slow or confusion, and the stim clears the ones already on. Slows from water, snow and carried objectives stay. The Status effect immunity option turns this off.

A downed Helldiver can use a stim to get back up and heal, unless the Allow downed stim option is off.

Passive health regeneration is off: health comes back through stims and other healing. The Preserve passive healing option keeps it. With the Autoinjector perk, the extra regeneration of the perk stays either way.

The loadout card shows a syringe right of the weapon, one charge per stim, spent from the needle down. Other players see the motion and the count of each Helldiver.

- Every player in the lobby runs the mod, at the same version and option values.

| Preserve passive healing | Off | Keeps the slow health regeneration of the game. The Autoinjector perk bonus stays either way. |
| Status effect immunity | On | No status effects while a stim lasts, apart from water, snow and carry slows. |
| Allow downed stim | On | A downed Helldiver can use a stim to get back up and heal. |
| Stim sound volume | 0.7 | How loud the stim sound plays. Other players' stims nearby play quieter. |
| Use a stim (key) | V | The key that uses a stim. |

## Notes

- The stim sound plays through Windows, outside the game's own volume settings.
- Other players see a stim about a second after it happens.

mods.name: Rank Cap 500
mods.summary: Raises the maximum rank from 50 to 500, with a unique title for every new rank (450 names in English and Russian) and a gentler XP curve. Mission XP is multiplied so the ladder stays reachable; pick the multiplier in the mod options.
mods.description:
**English** · [Русский](#rank-cap-500--helldivers-1-1)

A mod for **HELLDIVERS 1** (Steam) that raises the maximum rank from **50 to 500**.
Every one of the 450 new ranks gets its own title and its own badge, in English and Russian.

Author: **bbb.exe** · Version: **1.6.6** (see `obsidian.json`)

## Features

- **450 new ranks (51–500).** The vanilla progression table is extended, not replaced, so ranks 1–50 and their rewards behave exactly as before.
- **A unique title for every rank** – 450 hand-written names in English and Russian, from *Supreme Admiral of Super Earth* to *Eternal Admiral-God of Super Earth* at rank 500.
- **A unique badge for every rank.** All 450 crests are built from the real vanilla rank icons (43–50 and their variants) and differ in **both shape and colour**: a gold → orange → red ramp ending in bright scarlet at rank 500.
- **A gentler XP curve.** Rank 51 costs 7,139,381 total XP and rank 500 costs 42,498,131, spread evenly over 450 ranks.
- **Configurable mission XP multiplier:** 1x, 2x, **3x (default)**, 4x, 5x or 10x.

## Requirements

- HELLDIVERS 1 (Steam)
- [Obsidian Mod Manager](https://github.com/obsidian-mod-manager/obsidian-mod-manager)

## Repository layout

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `main.lua` | Entry point: extends `ProgressionSettings.ranks`, installs localisation hooks and the badge lookup |
| `titles.lua` | Module with all 450 rank titles (English + Russian) |
| `obsidian.json` | Mod metadata, options and the list of 900 texture/material resources |
| `res/icons/` | 450+ exported `.texture` badge assets used by the mod |
| `res/icons.material` | Single material resource with 450 named sub-materials (`rank500_icon_NNN`) |
| `internal/` | Development-only sheets and preview images |
| `tools/` | Python generators: icons, sheets, banner, material, previews, release packer and verifier |
| `banner.png`, `banner-nexus-1300x372.png`, `image.png` | Mod page artwork / mod icon |

### Building from source

The generators in `tools/` need Python 3.12+ with `Pillow` and `numpy`. Note that the scripts
use absolute paths to the installed mod folder (`C:/Users/username/AppData/Local/ObsidianModManager/...`)
and to the release directory (`E:/HD1-Mods`); adjust the constants at the top of each script
for your machine.

```powershell
python tools/build_rank_icons.py          # generate per-rank badge textures
python tools/build_combined_material.py   # merge them into res/icons.material
python tools/build_previews.py            # regenerate internal/previews/*
python tools/pack_release.py              # build the release zip
python tools/verify_release.py            # check the archive
```

## Multiplayer

Scope is `client`: the extended ranks, titles and badges live in your game.
A player **with the same mod** receives your real rank number and resolves it through the same 1–500 table, so they see the correct rank and title. A player **without** the mod has no rank entry above 50 and sees a clamped/vanilla value; titles are localisation keys on each client, so nothing custom is shown on their screen.

## Notes and uninstall

- Do not run the "16 Players" mod together with this one.
- If a deploy fails, delete the mod folder, re-extract it and deploy again.
- To uninstall: disable the mod, press **Deploy** once, then delete `Rank-Cap-500`.

# Rank Cap 500 – HELLDIVERS 1 (русский)

[English](#rank-cap-500--helldivers-1) · **Русский**

Мод для **HELLDIVERS 1** (Steam), который повышает максимальный ранг с **50 до 500**.
Каждый из 450 новых рангов получил своё звание и свой значок – на английском и русском языках.

Автор: **bbb.exe** · Версия: **1.6.6** (см. `obsidian.json`)

## Что делает мод

- **450 новых рангов (51–500).** Ванильная таблица прогрессии расширяется, а не заменяется: ранги 1–50 и их награды работают точно так же, как раньше.
- **Уникальное звание для каждого ранга** – 450 вручную написанных названий на английском и русском: от *Supreme Admiral of Super Earth* до *Eternal Admiral-God of Super Earth* на 500-м ранге.
- **Уникальный значок для каждого ранга.** Все 450 эмблем собраны из настоящих ванильных иконок рангов (43–50 и их вариантов) и отличаются **и формой, и цветом**: плавный переход золото → оранжевый → красный, который заканчивается ярко-алым на 500-м ранге.
- **Более мягкая кривая опыта.** Ранг 51 требует 7 139 381 очка опыта, ранг 500 – 42 498 131; это равномерно распределено на 450 рангов.
- **Настраиваемый множитель опыта за миссии:** 1x, 2x, **3x (по умолчанию)**, 4x, 5x или 10x.

## Требования

- HELLDIVERS 1 (Steam)
- [Obsidian Mod Manager](https://github.com/obsidian-mod-manager/obsidian-mod-manager)

## Установка

1. Закройте HELLDIVERS 1.
2. Откройте **Obsidian Mod Manager → Mods**.
3. Нажмите **Add mods** и выберите архив релиза (`hd1-rank-cap-500-v1.6.6.zip`).
   Вручную: распакуйте архив в `%LOCALAPPDATA%/ObsidianModManager/mods/` так, чтобы появилась папка `Rank-Cap-500` – менеджер подхватит её так же.
4. Включите **Rank Cap 500** в списке модов.
5. Выберите множитель опыта в настройках мода (по умолчанию 3x).
6. Нажмите **Deploy**, затем **PLAY**.
